FN-I35Q766-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 284
Committee: Banking and Insurance Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 04/08/2025
Senate Bill 284 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Department
of Finance and Office of Information Technology by an estimated amount of $52,500 to develop
a strategic plan to implement this blockchain.
Additionally, this bill could increase costs of the State Comptroller by an undetermined amount,
dependent upon the software and personnel required to publish public expenditures.
